title: Canonical inventory ledger quantity and immutable monthly storage billing

acceptanceCriteria.description: Signed immutable inventory movements and the backend inventory read model own quantity; callers no longer own or repair a parallel stock balance.
Storage billing has one stable UTC calendar-month identity, frozen proof, and admin-only audited edits while finalized billing remains immutable.
Client Portal renders canonical PrepShip inventory and billing DTOs, production fails closed to portal-only routes, and no independent invoice mutation or client-specific money override remains.
Additive preparation, append-only correction, destructive cutover, and both rollback phases are guarded, repeatable, and verified against migrated offline database fixtures.

A fresh exact-SHA read-only packet confirms 49 correction rows totaling +1,000 units with zero ambiguous rows, but production remains unmodified until DJ separately approves the maintenance window, production migrations, correction movements, push, and deployment.

canonicalOwners: src/services/inventory-movement.ts owns append-only movement writes and direction validation
src/services/inventory-reconciliation.ts and src/services/inventory-correction-plan.ts own read-only reconciliation and deterministic correction plans
src/services/billing-storage.ts owns calendar-month storage periods and proof math
src/services/billing.ts owns generated billing lines and monthly storage persistence

sotBypass.details: Routes and UIs are thin consumers; quantity, billing month identity, billing money, and correction policy remain in backend or database canonical owners.

Never rewrite ledger history; reverse an approved correction only with separately approved append-only inverse movements.
